evidence.reason: Removed metering.initialize() call and changed plan argument from "monthly" to "benchmark", altering runtime behavior relied on by tests.
New function mutates shared history via splice and reads configuration.rate and chargeUnit, introducing stateful side effects that interact with subscriptionCharge's dependency on chargeUnit.
Test asserts subscriptionCharge(40) > 0 and historySize() > 0, both of which depend on the removed initialize() call and the changed plan string.

result.userExplanation: 左改动删除了初始化并改了计费方案字符串，右改动新增了会修改共享历史的函数，两者合并后可能让订阅计费测试失败，但证据有限，建议先警告。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/subscription.ts#subscriptionCharge 的作者恢复 metering.initialize() 调用，并确认 "benchmark" 方案是否应替代 "monthly"；同时请 src/metering.ts#usageChargeV2 的作者避免在计费函数中直接 splice 共享 history，改为返回新数组或使用局部状态。
